name: Rescue at-risk appointments with a two-hour WhatsApp check-in

parameters.content:
## Rescue at-risk appointments with a two-hour WhatsApp check-in

### How it works
1. Every hour, appointments are read and validated; broken rows go to an error log.
2. Unconfirmed appointments starting in 90-150 minutes get one WhatsApp check-in.
3. A static-data guard guarantees exactly one check-in per appointment.
4. Replies are classified (YES/NO, English and Dutch) and routed: confirmed updates the calendar, anything else flags staff.

### Setup steps
- Import into n8n, then replace the demo data node with your Google Sheets source (columns are listed in the node).
- Put a WhatsApp Business Cloud send node in place of the placeholder and wire the Wait node's resume webhook to your inbound webhook.
- Point the two replace-me nodes at your calendar update and staff channel.

### Requirements
n8n on any plan. The demo run needs no credentials; production needs a Sheets or calendar credential plus WhatsApp Business Cloud.

### Customization
The window (90-150 minutes), the wait time (15 minutes), and the YES/NO keywords (English and Dutch variants) are plain settings in the named nodes.

## 1. Data + validate
Hourly trigger plus appointment source. A code node validates every row; broken rows go to an error log with the exact reason.

## 2. T-2h check-in
One WhatsApp question per unconfirmed appointment 90-150 minutes before start. A static-data guard prevents double sends.

## 3. Reply handling
Wait for the reply and classify it. Confirmed updates the calendar; cancel, unclear and no-reply flag staff.
